description: This app's own two commands, plus scoped doors: the window may ask the OS to open the project's issue tracker, to reveal a file inside the Screepub library, and to ask the updater plugin to check, download and install. The updater grant has no allow-list to write; its scope is the one endpoint in tauri.conf.json. Nothing else. The shell and dialog plugins are still used only from Rust. See ADR 2026-09-21 — doors, not commands.
